reader.requirement: In sequential access the DELETE is legal only when the last I-O statement on the file was a successful READ (else status 43, nothing removed) and it removes the record that READ accessed, whatever the prime key item now holds.

reader.notes: The 43 gate is one flag dropped by every status assignment and re-armed only by a successful READ's terminal, so OPEN, START, REWRITE, DELETE and an at-end READ all close it; the sequential arm deletes _lastReadPrime, not the area's key.
